Predict soil properties from a spectral data frame

Source: R/predict.R
predict_soil.Rd

Resamples user spectra to the family's canonical grid, applies the family's preprocessing pipeline (Safanelli's SNV for Cubist; SG-smooth + masked SNV for masked VAE), generates a per-sample coverage mask from the resampled NA pattern, and dispatches to the appropriate model loader.

Usage

predict_soil(
  df,
  family_id,
  properties = NULL,
  model_dir = getOption("autoSpectra.model_dir", "models"),
  disable_pp = FALSE,
  with_pi = FALSE,
  confidence = 0.68
)

Arguments

df

Data frame with a Soil_ID column and numeric spectral columns named by wavelength (nm) or wavenumber (cm-1)

family_id

Family identifier from model_registry

properties

Properties to predict (default: all)

model_dir

Root directory where models are stored

disable_pp

Skip preprocessing (debug only)

with_pi

Include prediction intervals when available (Cubist family)

confidence

Confidence level for prediction intervals (default 0.68)

Value

Data frame with Soil_ID, one column per predicted property, and (when with_pi=TRUE) *_lo/*_hi interval columns
